verdict.rationale: Snyk offers programmatic access via a well-documented CLI (snyk-gh-1/3, snyk-docs-1..) and an MCP server for agentic integration (snyk-docs-28, snyk-probe-3), which let AI-native users drive scans and fixes without a UI. However, an explicit documented public REST/OpenAPI interface could not be confirmed — probes for openapi.json/swagger.json all returned 404 (snyk-probe-2), so there's no clear evidence of a formal public API spec beyond CLI/MCP tooling. Missing for 10: a documented REST/GraphQL API reference or OpenAPI spec, and independent confirmation that third-party AI agents can call it directly.
